product_one_liner.value: Rasayel is a WhatsApp sales platform for B2B teams that centralizes conversations, automates follow-ups, and syncs customer activity with their CRM.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page with named plans and prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are featured in Rasayel customer success stories.

employee_band.notes: Available counts of 15–16 employees fall within this band.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows sales and marketing guides, product content, and customer stories rather than qualifying engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes multiple articles covering the inbox, templates, campaigns, automation, and integrations.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists Senior Software Engineer only; no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title is listed.

model_provider.notes: No underlying AI model or provider was publicly identified in the reviewed product documentation, Support AI page, Cleo announcement, security policy, or privacy-policy provider list.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy describes GDPR legal bases and data-protection rights; this is not an independently audited certification. Stripe's PCI certification is not counted as Rasayel's.

last_funding.notes: Latest listed round; the amount is undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed funding is the February 2022 seed round, before the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists Senior Software Engineer only; no SDR, BDR, or account executive opening is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest launch-type changelog entry found is automated HubSpot property updates on April 28, 2026, before the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small team page and available executive histories show no qualifying join or departure during the requested window; both listed executives are co-founders whose Rasayel tenure predates it.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are publicly documented integrations, not confirmation that Rasayel uses each as its own internal sales stack.
